grader.scenario: TV 4K box audio description voice synthesizer stuck on across all channels; cleared via remote audio PID multiplexer reset; two handled outbursts
grader.notes: Flawless call featuring two handled outbursts with deep empathy, remote audio multiplexer reset, harmless recheck in the final third, and complete live resolution verification.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net TV technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Valerie throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent handled two separate customer emotional outbursts with deep empathy at turns 16 and 22, and no unhandled outbursts occurred.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased the persistent audio description voice narration issue at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent completed harmless recheck of customer address at turn 42.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent transmitted audio multiplexer reset, locked decoder configuration, and verified multiple channels and recordings live.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, warm, and highly supportive professional demeanor throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed about power cycling history and specific channel behavior.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Live testing on BBC One, Channel 4, and French on-demand recording confirmed pristine audio with zero voice narration.
